definition: All original ROIs, four events, native half-open 500-ms optical windows; paired Wilcoxon zsplit Q1 and baseline-subtracted unpaired Mann-Whitney Q2; raw p<0.05 and abs(MI)>0.1, either sign; no amplitude or Hz gate. BH across all original ROIs per session/signal/event, plus across-event alternatives.
unit_table_definition: All original ROI/event/signal identities with eligibility and response classifications; C1 pre/post Q2 and joint testability/responsiveness flags. Per-repeat p/MI values are computed and validated during extraction; only their classifications are retained in this compact publication table. Separate all-event dF/F statistics preserve the complete publication example cohort.
